title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: If your average score on your first six mathematics tests was \(84\) and your average score on your first seven mathematics tests was \(85,\) then your score on the seventh test was

solutions.text:
Seven tests averaging \(85\) total \(7 \times 85 = 595\) points; six tests averaging \(84\) total \(6 \times 84 = 504\) points.

The seventh score is \(595 - 504 = 91.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The total for seven tests is \(7 \times 85,\) and the total for six tests is \(6 \times 84\)
The seventh score is the difference between those two totals
